finding_fixed: P1 abort plus accepted status could latch faulted while suppressing both abort and later normal completion.
fix: Abort suppresses new normal completion, overrides new status-derived response with code 0x50, and uses one pending bit to serialize code 0x50 behind an already offered response without popping the FIFO head.
